targets.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic =~ /homepulse\/${property}/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement: strings.split(v: r.topic, t: "/")[2]}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

import "strings"

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity")

import "strings"

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic =~ /homepulse\/${property}/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement: strings.split(v: r.topic, t: "/")[2]}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_measurement"])

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity")

import "strings"

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "door_open" or r._field == "window_open")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic =~ /homepulse\/${property}/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement: strings.split(v: r.topic, t: "/")[2] + " - " + r._field}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])
